target_customer: Teams running AI agents in production that want lower inference cost and better reliability
problem: Production agents spend heavily on frontier model tokens and fail mid run. ReasonBlocks uses agent traces to build specialized models and a runtime layer to cut cost and errors.
business_model: Usage-based infrastructure platform and SDK (pricing not found)
product_category: AI agent runtime layer and specialized model training

founders.name: Sajeev Magesh
founders.background_notes: Published in Nature Sustainable Agriculture on ML for agriculture and won a UN Best Paper award per the YC page.

founders.name: Rohan Vij
founders.background_notes: Has worked with Sajeev since second grade per the YC page.

competitors.name: Laminar
competitors.what: Trace analysis model for agent debugging, launched at YC with flow-1

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires training, routing and serving specialized models from production traces plus runtime correction, with accuracy gains hard to prove.

defensibility.rationale: Customer traces could become a data moat, but distillation is a well published technique and little traction is shown.

market_need_then: Agent inference cost and reliability were widely discussed pain points in 2026, supported by academic work on agent distillation published in 2025 and 2026.

identity.voice_and_tone: Not described; site fetch returned little content

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found; a search for the name returned only unrelated results.

outcome_analysis: ReasonBlocks is a Spring 2026 company with no exit and no verified funding. The founders are young and technical, but a third party listing found little press or traction evidence. The wedge of cheaper agents is crowded and exposed to inference price cuts from model providers.
notes: CB Insights lists 500K USD via convertible note with YC as investor, and VCBacked lists a June 2026 pre-seed with no amount; both aggregators, so unverified and not recorded as rounds. The company site fetch returned no content. Founded year not found. Sources disagree on the co-founder name (Sajeev alone vs Rohan Vij); the YC page names both. Laminar source is dated before the batch.
